name: code-review-kit
riskyAreas: scripts/lib/: every script depends on it
scripts/structure/, release/, testmap/, agents/, perf/: a wrong finding sends the owner the wrong way
scripts/summary/: the verdict and the page

design.goal: A reusable, dependency-free review kit: scripts count, independent agents verify, the owner decides. Findings first, fixes only after the owner chooses.
mustNeverHappen: a reviewer that edits the project
a wrong finding presented as verified
a gated check that silently passes
next: add a new check to a script
